package runforkreadiness

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/events"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/contracts"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/core/agentidentity"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/core/flowidentity"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/core/forkrecipient"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/executionmode"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/runfork"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/semanticview"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/testfixtures/canonicalrouting"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// Diagnostic component probe at 0e3d6d99c; not fork execution or a default-suite test.
func TestSelectedKeylessActorProjectionProbe(t *testing.T) {
	root := canonicalrouting.CopySelectedInputAgentProbe(t)
	childDir := filepath.Join(root, "templ/child")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(childDir, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for name, body := range map[string]string{
		"schema.yaml": "name: child\npins:\n  inputs:\n    events: [work.ready]\n",
		"events.yaml": "work.ready:\n",
		"agents.yaml": "worker:\n  model: regular\n  intent:\n    inline: Consume the exact selected input.\n  subscriptions: [work.ready]\n",
	} {
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(childDir, name), []byte(body), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	repo := canonicalrouting.RepoRoot(t)
	bundle, err := contracts.LoadWorkflowContractBundleWithOverrides(repo, root, contracts.DefaultPlatformSpecFile(repo))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	source, runID := semanticview.Wrap(bundle), uuid.NewString()
	parent := flowidentity.Derive(source, "templ", "one")
	child, err := flowidentity.KeylessChild(source, parent, "templ/child")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := child.ValidateConstruction(source, runID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	owner, found := semanticview.AgentDeclarationOwner(source, "templ/child", "worker")
	if !found {
		t.Fatal("missing exact agent declaration")
	}
	name, err := agentidentity.DeclaredName("worker", owner)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	route, err := child.Route().AgentIdentityRoute()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	agent, err := agentidentity.NewPlan(name, route)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	recipient, err := forkrecipient.NewLocal(forkrecipient.Input{Recipient: events.MustAgentDeliveryRecipient(agent.AgentID()), Path: child.InstancePath, AgentPlan: agent, HandlerEvent: "work.ready"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	entered := time.Now().UTC()
	plan := runfork.RunForkPlan{SourceRunID: runID, Entities: []runfork.RunForkEntityState{{
		EntityID: child.EntityID, CurrentState: "active", EnteredStateAt: &entered,
		MaterializationMetadata: &runfork.RunForkMaterializedEntitySnapshotMetadata{
			Owner: runfork.RunForkMaterializedEntitySnapshotMetadataOwner,
			Source: runfork.RunForkMaterializedEntitySnapshotMetadataSourceFlowInstance,
			Mode: "static", FlowTemplate: "templ/child", FlowInstance: child.InstancePath,
			FlowConfig: selectedAgentHeaderConfig(t, child),
		},
	}}}
	if _, found, err := selectedContractReadinessEntityForRoute(source, plan, "templ/child", child.InstancePath); err != nil || !found {
		t.Errorf("fixed receiving header lookup: found=%v err=%v", found, err)
	}
	planning := runfork.RunForkSelectedContractRecipientPlanning{RecipientPlanEvents: []runfork.RunForkSelectedContractRecipientPlanEvent{{SourceEventID: "input", EventName: "work.ready", Recipients: []runfork.RunForkContractFrontierRecipient{recipient}}}}
	projection, err := Project(plan, source, planning, map[string]executionmode.Mode{"input": executionmode.Live}, templateAdmissionRequest(t).ModelOptions)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, blueprint := range projection.Blueprints {
		t.Logf("projected actor: %s", blueprint.Identity.Description())
		if blueprint.Identity == agent {
			return
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("fixed constructor owns %s; projection omitted exact actor %s (states=%d, flows=%d)", child.InstancePath, agent.Description(), len(projection.States), len(projection.Flows))
}
